context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on operations
purpose: Teach: 指針/区分/補正/集約/選考/単価/助手/裁量

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 方針は指針として書き、裁量権を明確に区分しろ。
lines.en: Write policy as guidance, not prescription. Draw the line between direction and discretion clearly.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried. Opens with quiet authority—no need to assert. Slight pause between clauses. The weight of experience settling into each phrase. Calm eye-level gaze.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しております。単価補正、現場主導で進めています。
lines.en: Understood. We're driving the unit-cost adjustments from the field level.
lines.style: Respectful but direct. Clipped confidence—showing he's already in motion on this. Not seeking approval so much as reporting. Steady shoulder posture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 選考過程の集約、若手育成にもなる。
lines.en: Consolidating the selection process does double duty—develops the next generation at the same time.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the observation. Quiet approval in the tone. Slow unfold of the logic, like showing a path. Not lecturing—pointing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 助手にも、適切に経験を積ませます。
lines.en: The assistants will get proper hands-on experience along the way.
lines.style: Steady, assured. A small nod in the voice. Not defensive—stating what will happen as fact. Grounded in his own commitment to it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Brief, warm approval. Slight lift at 'Good'—the benediction of someone who knows the work matters. Releasing him back to it with quiet confidence.
